items.headline: Lithium miners post big profits as battery storage demand surges
items.snippet: US-headquartered Albemarle Corp. said global lithium demand grew 45% through May from a year earlier, outstripping supply growth.

items.headline: AI Energy Storage Demand Ignites Lithium Prices, Lithium Mining Giants See "Second Growth Engine"
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB.US), the world's largest lithium producer, data confirms this trend. Global lithium demand has increased by 45% year-on-year.

items.headline: ALB vs. SQM: Which Lithium Stock Should You Bet on Now?
items.snippet: Albemarle is well-placed to gain from long-term growth in the battery-grade lithium market. ALB expects lithium demand to witness a CAGR of 10-20% from 2025 to 2030.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: JPMorgan now expects lithium prices to remain in the low-$20-per-kilogram range. Third-Quarter Profit Expected to Fall.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB) will likely benefit from factors like its low-cost assets, brownfield opportunity, as well as continued focus on earnings improvement in Specialties, RBC Capital Markets said.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares.
